content: Infravision is a special ability that allows characters in Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition II to see in the dark. This ability grants characters the ability to see heat signatures and detect creatures even in total darkness. This can be particularly useful in dimly lit areas or when facing creatures that hide in the shadows.
